verdict.rationale: Vercel documents built-in monitoring of traffic, function performance, and errors with framework-aware insights (vercel-docs-30). The toolbar can inspect performance (vercel-docs-7), and a first-party web analytics capability can be queried for visitors, page views, and custom events (vercel-supp-mcp-tools), which together cover both performance and visitor behavior. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party web analytics doc covering dashboards, retention, and filtering; documented real-user performance metrics such as Core Web Vitals; independent or hands-on corroboration.
